name: Wizard task-list shell
purpose: Owns the task-list surface of the wizard: the ordered enumeration of steps, the per-step completion-state slot from the closed GOV.UK vocabulary, the ARIA progressbar wrapper, and the linear-or-free navigation gate. Every AC on REQ-001 anchors on this TAC, and every AC that reads step order anchors here.
responsibilities: Enumerate every step in a stable order derived from the elicited step manifest and render one [data-step-slug] row per step (AC-24101-1).
Render [data-step-state] on every row from the closed enum {Cannot start yet, Not started, In progress, Completed} (AC-24101-1).
Render an ARIA progressbar wrapper on the surface with aria-valuenow (completed count), aria-valuemax (total step count) and aria-valuetext naming the completion in words (AC-24101-1).
Honour the ADR-2501 linear-vs-free branch by rendering rows whose prerequisites are unfinished as non-anchor spans on linear and as anchors on free (AC-24106-1).
Delegate to TAC-2503 to hydrate step states from the draft store on entry and to persist step completion transitions on advance.
renderSummaryReview: render the per-step summary-list at review time with Change links returning to each step and retaining every other answer on save (REQ-004).

applyElicits: at apply time, dispatch each of the five answer families to its owner interface: `step-manifest` populates the step order enumerated by the task-list; `navigation` picks the linear-or-free branch on the task-list; `step-indicator` selects the indicator surface owned by `ADR-2503.decision`; `draft-transport` binds the draft-store backend on `TAC-2503`; `validation-policy` sets the timing gate on `TAC-2502.validationTimingGate`. Per REQ-006.
internalStructure: One task-list module the shell mounts on the /task-list route. On mount it reads the step manifest, reads the draft store for the operator's per-step answers, computes the per-step completion state from the answers, renders the enumeration, and wires the row-click handler to the linear-vs-free branch. On step advance the module recomputes the state for the just-completed step and updates the progressbar aria-valuenow. Framework is not prescribed; the module's interfaces are what the project realises against React, Vue, Svelte or vanilla DOM.

interfaces.name: renderTaskList
interfaces.description: renderTaskList({ manifest, answers, nav }) -> void. Renders the shell and wires the row handlers.

interfaces.name: computeStepState
interfaces.description: computeStepState({ step, answers }) -> stateString. Returns one of {Cannot start yet, Not started, In progress, Completed}.

interfaces.name: statesEnum
interfaces.description: The four state strings are the closed enum {"Cannot start yet", "Not started", "In progress", "Completed"}. A fifth state is a v1.1.0 minor bump.

dependencies.name: Draft store
dependencies.description: The task-list reads the draft store on entry and writes on advance.

tradeoffs: One task-list module keeps the enumeration deterministic and lint-checkable but ties every step to a manifest entry the project supplies. A project rendering the wizard without a task-list (a single-flow submit surface with no completion overview) does not apply this TAC; the wizard-shell TACs still hold. Known mechanism-reach gap: the pack asserts row order and state strings but does not additionally probe that focus moves to the task-list on route entry; a v1.1.0 minor bump can drive the accessibility tree.
